title: Tour of Niagara Falls with Boat Cruise
includes: When the Cruise is not in operation, it will be substituted for the Journey Behind the Falls.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Tour is subject to cancellation if we do not meet the minimum required amount of participants
Vehicle type is subject to change based on passenger volumes
Itinerary is subject to change without notice

In the event that the Hornblower Niagara cruises not in operation, we will substitute it with the Journey Behind the Falls. Typically the boat operates between May and October although circumstances beyond our control may prevent this from happening.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a 4 hour tour of Niagara Falls, with views of the Whirlpool, Floral Clock and enjoy a complimentary maple syrup tasting, all starting within Niagara itself!

Travel with a local licenced and certified tour guide, who will share interesting facts and history of the Niagara Region. Even travel the famous Niagara parkway, with many beautiful sights along the way!

*Please note the itinerary is subject to change 
**When the Hornblower Niagara Cruise is not in operation, it will be substituted for the Journey Behind the Falls. (Typically the Boat cruise operates from April-October)
